statement.text:
Suppose that G is a finite group, and A , A , A are subsets of G such that
                                                  1   2   3
the multiplication map A1 × A2 × A3 → G is bijective. Must the subgroup ⟨A2 ⟩
generated by A2 have order divisible by the cardinality |A2 |? This is Question 8 in
(G. M. Bergman, J. Iranian Math. Soc., 1 (2020), 157–161).
    It is known (ibid.) that the corresponding statement is true for the subgroups
⟨A1 ⟩ and ⟨A3 ⟩. Moreover, |A2 | will at least divide the order of the least subgroup
containing A2 and closed under conjugation by members of A1 , and similarly of the
least subgroup containing A2 and closed under conjugation by members of A3 .
                                                                    G. M. Bergman
  ∗ No, it need not (M. I. Kabenyuk, Preprint, 2021, https://arxiv.org/abs/2102.
08605).
